selection.policy: aggregate counts, all failing lessons, one complete successful lesson per band

text:
# generator-shortcuts

**Strongest simple canonical-fitting rival: rotate correctly, but always anchor
the result at the bottom-right panel origin.** It matches all three labeled
canonical pairs because their bottom-left bounding-box offsets are all (0,0).
It is not a correct generalization when the source is shifted in its panel.

An exact generated witness is case 2 in
`repo/generators/9d2f7c9e2ac4/counterexamples/offset_and_color_witnesses.json`:
seed **3790588094**, accepted sample index **2**, difficulty **easy**, no
overrides. It is also `lessons[0].instance.train[2]` in
`checks/lesson-census-v1.json`. The input is 10x10, the upper example color is 7,
the source color is 3, the source contains four cells, and its bbox offset is
**(0,1)**. That JSON stores the complete input, actual Racket output and every
refuted rival output. Resetting the column offset moves the predicted target
one column left and disagrees with the authority.

The final selected generator emits this case directly. The label came from
actual `runner.run_one` execution through the supported public command:

```sh
python3 review.py run python3 -m arcpuzzles lesson-census 9d2f7c9e2ac4 --per-band 100 --rotate-query --timeout 1800 --out ../checks/lesson-census-v1.json
```

The witness is bound to generator SHA-256
`8105b0c6704d022567a9681768c76fc3624d3be5c300b1b941a9fbc1494cf104`
and unchanged canonical rule hash `3d50e1ec984b`. The source-bound census records
both raw and executed callable rule hashes and the materialized instance hash.
Its corresponding independent hand-made support was also checked by public
`arcpuzzles apply`, with 4/4 valid Racket outputs, before implementation.

Seven further declared shortcuts fit all three canonical labels: swap offsets,
drop either offset, repeat either offset on both axes, reuse the template's row
offset, and choose the maximum foreground color. The same shifted witness also
refutes maximum-color copying (7 instead of 3) and several offset rivals. The
four-case set collectively refutes all eight even after any single query
holdout. Seventeen distinct rival rules were tested in the final 300-lesson /
1,200-rotation census; no ambiguity was observed.

Limits: all generated crosses are centered, source boxes are at most 3x3 and
contain 4..6 cells, and targets start empty. Midpoint separator detection,
rarest-foreground-color source selection, and clearing an already empty target
remain answer-equivalent there. Their equivalence is not a counterexample pass,
and no claim is made that the bounded population identifies every possible rule.
